strings: r_c0 reassures m_c that's it's alright - {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} just {VERB/m_c/need/needs} to focus on what's around {PRONOUN/m_c/object}. r_c0 prompts {PRONOUN/m_c/object}, asking what {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can see, hear, and feel.
Sometimes the world feels a bit off to m_c, distant and out of reach for reasons that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can't quite name.
m_c's whole body shakes, coiled and wound up with an energy that rises into something close to anxiety from the lack of realness to the world around {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
When the world feels distant to m_c, it worries {PRONOUN/m_c/object} greatly.
m_c has been feeling a little bit understimulated recently and is off balance as a result.
